LanguageData.VCEO_Module_AC20_Desc: A 20 mm autocannon: fast, flat-shooting, shreds infantry and light vehicles and wears down armoured cars.
LanguageData.VCEO_Module_Mortar81_Desc: Indirect fire over walls and hills. Accurate with a spotter, a gamble without one.
LanguageData.VCEO_Module_HMG50_Desc: Hits harder and further than a rifle-calibre gun and can deal with light armour.
LanguageData.VCEO_Module_AGL30_Desc: Lobs bursts of high-explosive grenades: deadly to infantry in the open and behind light cover, useless against armour.
LanguageData.VCEO_Module_ArmorKitLight_Desc: Extra steel plates bolted over the armour plating: +6 mm sharp / +60 MPa blunt.
